### Merry — *A Hearth’s Warming Tail* (G4)

**Who she is:** **Merry is Rarity’s storybook role** in Twilight Sparkle’s retelling of *A Hearth’s Warming Tale*, not a separate long-term disguise or the green Pegasus **Merry May**. She is a warmly dressed unicorn and a friend of **Snowdash** (Rainbow Dash’s role) and **Flutterholly** (Fluttershy’s role), helping show **Snowfall Frost** (Starlight Glimmer’s role) why Hearth’s Warming friendship matters.

**Recognize her:** Rarity’s **white coat, curled violet mane, blue eyes**, and an elaborate **burgundy/red-and-purple Victorian-style dress, bow and striped bonnet**. She appears at Snowdash’s festive gathering in **“A Hearth’s Warming Tail,” season 6, episode 8 (May 14, 2016)**, where she asks about Snowfall’s disdain for the holiday and later welcomes Snowfall to the celebration. [Episode summary](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/A_Hearth%27s_Warming_Tail).

**Name and voice:** The name is **spoken in the episode**, not merely a fan label: Snowdash greets her, **“Hey, Merry.”** The credits explicitly say **“Rarity / Merry,” voiced by Tabitha St. Germain**; Kazumi Evans is separately credited for Rarity’s singing in the episode, not a standalone Merry vocal performance. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/A_Hearth%27s_Warming_Tail) · [Season-six credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_six).

**Other continuity:** Gameloft’s licensed *My Little Pony* mobile game includes **Merry** as a collectible/quest character in the 2016 Hearth’s Warming event. Its characterization jokes that the character looks suspiciously like Rarity. This is an adaptation of the **named character inside Twilight’s fictional holiday tale**, not evidence of an additional pony sharing Rarity’s everyday identity. [2016 event quests](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Hearth%27s_Warming_2016_Quests).
